spans.s:
Ukṣaṇyāyana is mentioned in a Dānastuti (‘Praise of Gifts’)
in the Rigveda^1 along with Harayāṇa and Suṣāman. Ludwig^2
thinks that all three are identical. Roth^3 finds a reference to
Ukṣan himself in the verb ukṣaṇyati^4 and in the adjective
ukṣaṇyu.^5
1) viii. 25, 22.
2) Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 162,
270.
3) St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v.
4) Rv. viii. 26, 9.
5) Rv. viii. 23, 16.

Ukṣṇo-randhra Kāvya is mentioned as a seer in the Pañca-
viṃśa Brāhmaṇa (xiii. 9, 19).^1
1) Cf. Max Müller, Sacred Books of the East, 32, 397.
